form.appearanceHelp: Describe distinctive features, then choose appearance hints below. These choices build the linked prompt. Hair, clothes and gear are added later.
form.promptHelp: This exact text is sent to the selected model. Complete lines such as Kind: Elf update Appearance. Other text stays in Details; prose is never guessed as a trait.
form.selectToCopy: Select the text to copy it.
form.settingsChanged: Settings changed. Your text was kept.
form.noDetails: PixelLab returned no details. Your text was kept.
form.tooLong: The enhanced text is too long. Your text was kept.
form.detailsPlaceholder: A freckled elf with a kind face
form.baseClothingHelp: Plain white underwear is part of the base and may show through open clothing. Exact prompt edits can override this guidance. Review generated coverage.
form.bodySizeHelp: The source canvas the model draws into, in pixels—not a guaranteed opaque body height. This model accepts {min}–{max} pixels in {step} px steps. The frame adds space for movement and equipment.
form.frameHelp: The square cell used by every exported frame. Auto adds padding around the body canvas. Enter a larger value for more room, up to 256 px. Pixels are padded, never scaled.
form.frameAbove128: Above 128 px, items dress 4 views at a cost of 15–25 gens per call, with no repair-grid fallback.
form.frameAbove80: Above 80 px, items dress 4 views per call, so they can cost more.
form.cameraHelp: Low top-down shows a slight overhead view. High top-down looks down more steeply. Side is level with the character. Direction presets also set a suitable camera.
form.directionsHelp: Choose the views to keep and animate. V3 first creates all eight original views. Attached mirror buttons mirror a horizontal partner; a blue mirror button marks a derived view, so hands swap there (a Main hand sword appears in the left hand). Characters made with Unique 8 keep each hand. Turning it off uses that view’s original artwork. For one facing, choose Side-scroller 2 and turn W off.
form.modelHelp: The PixelLab model that draws the character. Each model accepts its own body sizes and options, so the controls change with it. Every model registers the character with V3, so moves and items work the same.
form.outlineHelp: Outline style guidance for Character V3. The model may not follow it exactly.
form.detailHelp: Detail level guidance for Character V3. The model may not follow it exactly.
form.seedHelp: Controls the random starting point for character generation. Moves added later pick their own seeds. It does not randomize one specific trait. Leave blank for a fresh seed. Reusing it can give similar results, but does not guarantee identical pixels.
